core_rule: Bentosaur dinosaurs are cute upright bipeds. They stand, walk, carry, cook, gesture, and emote on two weight-bearing hind legs. Their forelimbs behave as free arms or hands and never become a second pair of walking legs.

full_body_contract.posture: upright or gently forward-leaning from the hips
required_reads: two distinct hind legs or an unambiguous biped stride
both forearms held above the ground
pelvis and torso elevated above the feet
tail projecting behind or to one side as counterbalance

proportion_guides.tone: cute and compact but not crawling, pet-like, or quadrupedal
proportion_guides.forearms: small but clearly articulated as arms; capable of holding a tray, umbrella, ingredient, cup, book, or cheek
proportion_guides.feet: broad enough to sell balance and readable at 64 source pixels

pose_classes.neutral_full_body: upright on two planted hind feet, arms relaxed or gesturing, tail balancing the silhouette
pose_classes.service_walk: alternating hind-leg stride while both arms carry a bento or prop; no forelimb ground contact
pose_classes.counter_host: upright body behind the counter; hands may support cheeks or interact with food
pose_classes.portrait_or_emote: head, frill, shoulders, and hands may fill the crop; the legs can be omitted because this is not a locomotion asset

asset_separation_contract.generation_rule: Generate and maintain every character master as an isolated prop-free, clothing-free character. Permanent body colors and facial surfaces belong to the character. Accessories, scenery, and VFX are separate assets and are deferred for the first production proof.

assembly.boundary_test: If removing an element changes species identity or bare neutral anatomy, it belongs to the character master. If it can be swapped between compatible customers, it is a prop or accessory.

forbidden: forefeet or knuckles touching the ground
forelimbs rendered as a second pair of feet
tail omitted from a side or three-quarter full-body sprite

references.usage: Upright biped body plan, two-leg service walk, free forearms, and tail counterbalance only; do not copy its background or tray.
Front-facing Triceratops frill, horn placement, hands, and delighted expression only.
Bentosaur sage, cream, and coral identity; outline, shading, and cozy pixel-art treatment.

positive: standing on exactly two weight-bearing hind legs
two short free forearms used as hands
long visible tail used as counterbalance
isolated prop-free character with empty hands
negative: no props, clothing, accessories, platform, or scenery

automatic_reject_if: more or fewer than two weight-bearing legs
the back reads horizontal in a neutral or walk pose
the tail is missing in a side or three-quarter full-body view
the body plan cannot carry a tray with both arms while walking
an animation changes from biped to quadruped
semantic_qa.human_review_question: Could this dinosaur walk into the stall carrying a bento with both hands without changing its anatomy?
